EntraId._comment: Placeholders — not real values. Fill in from the API's Azure App Registration once it exists (docs/architecture/00-analysis.md §18). Until then every request is correctly rejected as unauthenticated.

MicrosoftGraph._comment: Placeholders — not real values. App-only (client credentials) access to search the tenant directory, used to pre-provision users before their first login. Requires the Graph application permission User.Read.All with admin consent and a client secret on the same App Registration as EntraId — see docs/security/entra-id-setup.md. Leave ClientSecret empty (set via user-secrets/Key Vault/env var) to disable this feature safely; the search endpoint then returns a clear 'not configured' error instead of pretending to work.
